name: goat-id-console-web-e2e
description: Playwright e2e for goat-id-console: the candidate intake form (web/static/onboard.html) and the /onboarding review page. Mocked mode serves web/static/ from a stdlib static server and stubs /api/onboard/* via page.route; the review-page specs start a real console from ../../cmd/console against throwaway SQLite files (no Kratos). Live mode (INTAKE_URL set) drives a real goatnet's public intake page.
